boundaries: The approved October 14 removals remain in force.
The dedicated image editor remains deferred.
Provider capability, adapter, runtime and commercial acceptance are separate.
Archived exact prototype fixtures are preserved; they were not individually requalified as current independent screen designs.
The 640 × 360 desktop preview cap and conversation-header plus remain approved constraints.
The new selected-phrase color token has no claimed existing CSS variable mapping.

findings.resolution: Reserved history space and kept the newest status/actions visible in 96 active history regions and consolidated sources.
Replacement panels sit above the composer with clearance from explicit inputs; close, options and Suggest have adequate touch targets.
Canonical 64px mobile navigation, 44px controls, responsive composer controls, and six unused desktop-only layers removed.
Three retained screens and 31 reusable composer states use the canonical rail and 336px composer; model/settings/input values are retained.
Seven rail destination variants and shared hover/focus labels; layers and prototype hit areas follow the visible controls.
Request and output-slot failures show a reason and direct Retry. The original request/slot remains; a separate retry has its own outcome fixture.
Owner image toolbars show Fullscreen, Use and Download without Play, Time, Seek or Volume. Contextual image actions remain under Use; public-viewer permissions remain separate.
Stopped and ended timestamps differ, seek endpoints are correct, and ended playback uses Replay. State-specific time properties avoid a shared-default defect.
Removed misleading credit quantities and vague allowance copy. Free testing has no customer-credit balance; existing action limits remain and no reset date is invented.
Filter and sort are distinct labelled menus; visibility is a real toggle. This retains the existing filter options instead of inventing a new segmented-filter taxonomy.
Projects search uses the correct placeholder, and sample cards have distinct edit-date/item-count metadata.
Audio-entry actions consistently say Add audio.
Removed obsolete Pricing navigation from shared headers, footers, mobile menus and prototype hit areas; archived pricing was not restored.
Project-name width hugs its text so the dropdown is adjacent.
Details is explicitly labelled Media details; navigation has tooltips. The conversation-header plus is retained under the approved chrome contract.
Kept the approved 640 by 360 desktop preview maximum and aspect-ratio policy rather than enlarging previews based solely on the percentage-of-pane observation.

Fresh owns the current shared color roles. Fourteen overlapping Model colors and matching dimensions alias Fresh; phrase roles are in Fresh; compatibility/exploration collections are retained and hidden from publishing.
Current product surfaces use Inter; settings chips use the Fresh label style.
Replaced the imported blue action treatment with the existing white primary and dark foreground.

Visible desktop editor docks stay fixed, applicable Add media actions are consistent, and track labels preserve clip/time geometry. Mobile shown/hidden timeline docks retain the same viewport position.
Error, warning and success roles are documented; failure labels/icons use danger. Failure words and category cues do not rely on color alone.
Disabled controls have a distinct treatment and empty auth forms provide readable inline reasons. Empty password placeholders are muted.
Seven guides use shared headers, link cards and a compact grid. Stale counts, empty rows and a nonfunctional leftover row are removed; consolidated links resolve to retained surfaces.
Current component families use the Fresh namespace and toolbar menus have readable names; historical/reference assets retain their provenance.
The four retained account screens have a rail spanning the full viewport.
Desktop and mobile navigation, account lists, search results and section menus align left.
The command-key hint is inside the shared search control.
Source-level repairs cover composer actions, attachment removal, Sketch tools, sheet/header controls, public menu buttons, seek controls and their prototype hit areas.
Retained interface text is at least 12px; clipped timeline label boxes adapt to available clip width with truncation.
Subject, motion, lighting and environment use distinct underline patterns alongside their colors and readable category labels; prompt text is unchanged.
Current section and variant layouts were reflowed and checked for overlaps while retaining screen/component identities.
The rendered pass caught and corrected a copied search placeholder, import-sheet background, zero-width auth-helper lines and remaining mobile menu alignment overrides.

rendering.method: Native Figma PNG renders. The initial pass used page contact sheets and selected full-size renders; it missed attachment icon collisions. The attachment-control-remediation-2026-10-14.json correction contains the subsequent close-up and overlap verification.

corrections.finding: Remove X overlays the image thumbnail and coincides with the audio/status glyph, including the invalid Beat.wav attachment.
corrections.cause: The prior resize reduced Input preview from 112 by 80 to 40 by 40 and positioned every inner instance at the same upper-right anchor. That treated content/status glyphs and remove controls as the same role.
corrections.previousVerificationGap: The preceding geometry audit did not check sibling-region overlap. Screen contact sheets were too small to expose the attachment collision. Its overall completion claim overstated attachment verification.
corrections.closure: Reused the canonical input component with separated preview, identity and remove regions. Checked 68 source/consumer instances and visually inspected all 34 affected composer instances.
